summary: A chat assistant asks about your business and writes your setup files.

steps.title: Download
paragraphs: Click Download setup skill and save the zip.
On Windows, right-click the zip and choose Extract all.

steps.title: Open the folder
paragraphs: Open the folder for your chat tool.
Not sure? Use Claude in folder 1; you need an account with that tool.

options.name: Claude Desktop or Claude.ai
steps: In Settings, open Capabilities. Enable Code execution and file creation (also called Create and edit files).
Open Customize, then Skills. Click +, then Create skill, then Upload a skill.
Upload dreamlabs-sales-setup.zip from folder 1 without extracting it. Turn the skill on. Start a new chat.
Controls missing? Ask your Claude account admin or use folder 4.

options.name: ChatGPT
steps: If you can create or edit a GPT, open its configuration.
Under Knowledge, upload file-format.md, interview-guide.md and sequences.md. Save it and start a new chat with it.

options.name: Any other chat (paste)
steps: Open SKILL-single-file.md in a plain text editor.
Paste it into a new chat.

steps.title: Answer the questions
paragraphs: Tell your chat: Help me set up Dreamlabs Sales for my business.
Answer its questions in your own words.

steps.title: Save your files
paragraphs: If you receive text, use a plain text editor to save it, not Word.

steps.title: Import them
paragraphs: In Dreamlabs Sales Settings, click Import setup files and choose all finished .md files.
steps.note: Only an admin can upload the finished files. Not an admin? Send the files to your admin.

steps.title: Switch sequences on
paragraphs: Reload the page, then review and turn on each new sequence in the sequence editor.
New sequences start off; replacements keep their current on or off setting.

troubleshooting.title: Something went wrong?
tips: A wrong file type error means hard refresh (Ctrl+F5) and try again.
Ask your admin if the import button is missing.
